Fragile is a young woman who comes into contact with Sam at some point in Death Stranding. She bears the logo of Fragile Express, and has some executive role in a company.
Story
Fragile, at some point, offers Sam a job working for her, noting how hard it must be for him on his own in the world.

At another point, Fragile again meets Sam, just as BTs begin manifesting near him. After the entities leave, she sheds a tear and, with Sam, watches as five floating figures survey from the sky momentarily until they disappear. Afterwards, she warns Sam to be mindful of the mysterious entities' return and remarks that timefall cannot wash everything away – the ever-clinging past in particular – before departing.
Higgs and the Homo Demens manage to capture Fragile at some point, holding her at gunpoint in a ruined urban area. After triggering a storm, Higgs proceeds to lick her face.
Personality

Fragile portrays herself as controlled and intelligent, shown when she tells Sam to be quiet while under threat from BTs, clearly knowing how to effectively deal with them in a calm fashion. She also remains at ease when she is captured by the Homo Demens, despite being held at gunpoint.
Abilities
Like Sam, Fragile possesses the unique aspect of DOOMs. Her extinction factor is noted to be higher than Sam's.
Notes
Fragile was first introduced in the E3 2018 trailer.
Hideo Kojima has revealed that Fragile is a homage to Mary Poppins.
Kojima originally contacted Stefanie Joosten for the role of Fragile. However, she never followed up on the potential casting, and would instead cast Léa Seydoux for the role.

Afterwards, Asogi fled from the scene and was witnessed by a number of servants working for Klint, but there was not enough evidence to prove that he was responsible for Klint's death.

Klint's blackmailer, Stronghart, wanted to avoid people discovering the identity of the Professor (and subsequently, his own role in The Professor's murders) at all costs. Having become privy to the identity of The Professor, Asogi became a threat to Stronghart. To this end, Stronghart orchestrated a devious plan.

Stronghart coerced several people into helping him frame Asogi and make him appear to be The Professor. Tobias Gregson was coerced into ordering thugs to attack Asogi. These thugs attacked Asogi while he was outside with Barok van Zieks. Concealing that their true target was Asogi by pretending that their target was Barok, the thugs stole Asogi's trademark ring from him.

With this fabricated evidence, his ring, along with the previous witness testimonies, Stronghart managed to convince all relevant authorities that not only was Asogi responsible for the death of Klint, but was in actuality the notorious serial killer "The Professor" responsible for the deaths of four other nobles before Klint. In spite of Asogi not possessing The Professor's trademark weapon, he was arrested and detained as a prime suspect for The Professor.

After smuggling Asogi out of prison, initially the plan was to secretly retrieve Asogi from his grave in Lowgate Cemetery. Stronghart recruited Asogi's fellow student, Seishiro Jigoku, for the task by promising to help Jigoku secure the position of Minister of Foreign Affairs back in Japan. However, catastrophe would strike following an unforeseen event. Enoch Drebber, a local university student studying science, came to Lowgate Cemetry seeking fresh corpses to study.

Drebber selected the plot in which Asogi was located, unearthing him. He then witnessed Asogi 'rising from his grave'. Soon thereafter, Stronghart and Jigoku showed up to the grave, having discovered the fact that Drebber had seen Asogi alive.

Upon this discovery, Stronghart and Jigoku were seized with terror. They realized that Drebber would more than likely tell others that he had seen the Professor seemingly rise from the dead. This would in turn uncover the plot to break Asogi out of jail, and subsequently would reveal other related plots - such as the plot to conceal Klint van Zieks' identity as the Professor.

Unable to allow his plan to be ruined, Stronghart chose murder: he convinced Jigoku to murder Asogi by shooting him in the chest with a gun. The gunshot wound instantly killed Asogi, causing him to fall back into his now-real grave. The resulting blood splatter from the gunshot covered Drebber and his camera, leading to Drebber fleeing from the scene in terror. A high-school senior with a behaviour like that of a small animal. For better or for worse he has an innocent personality uncharacteristic for his age, and a strong sense of justice. He values love and peace, and adores delicious food to the point of being considered a glutton.

He has some extreme views and his outlook on life is kind of philosophical, but has a strong sense of responsibility. Most of the time he seems to be in a daze and this makes people think that his mind wanders through another dimension. Most likely an empath as the views of others can often grow on him and become his own.
Lives with his single father after having separated from his mother and younger brother.
Adapted from the official website and Twitter.

Rin is a third-year student at Saika Girls' Academy and the daughter of the school's headmaster. She has a playful personality, a passion for cute things, a keen sense of smell, and a deep knowledge of perfumes and aromas. She enjoys soaking in the natural scent of hot springs at the inn where Sora stays.
Rin holds the position of student council president but doesn't take her role too seriously. Despite this, she is a dependable and trusted figure for her peers during difficult times.
Rin often skips classes and falls asleep in the infirmary. She has been dealing with nightmares recently but hides her troubles and puts on a brave face for Sora.
"Cute, cute, cute! Take-home material!"
"Just call me 'Tsukimorin' as a cute nickname, okay♪."
"You have a talent for being naughty, don't you, Sensei?"
